faq.q: How do I install Shadow Fight 3 on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Shadow Fight 3 and check the developer is NEKKI before tapping Install. It needs Android 8.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from NEKKI and may be altered, so the safest way to play Shadow Fight 3 is the official listing.

faq.q: Which Shadow Fight 3 faction should I choose?
faq.a: Legion focuses on strength and defence, Dynasty on speed and agility, and Heralds on balance and spirit. Pick the style you enjoy; you can try others later in the story.
